acceptance_criteria: selects discovery as the only primary mode
requires or resolves board_id, year, and cycle_id
does not create spec package artifacts
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in discovery mode, resolve BOARD_ROOT, inspect repository evidence, and write only discovery artifacts.
scenarios.prompt: Discover candidate work from this repository into the MAGO board for board_id onboarding and year 2026 and cycle_id cycle-2026-04-01-q2-delivery.

acceptance_criteria: selects order mode
uses discovery artifacts as ordering evidence
creates or reconciles independent BOARD_ROOT/registry/<spec_id>.yaml records
does not create or hand-edit BOARD_ROOT/spec-catalog.yaml
does not create or hand-edit BOARD_ROOT/define-queue.yaml
runs board-level validators when authoritative artifacts change
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in order mode, create or reconcile one authoritative registry/<spec_id>.yaml record per candidate, and treat spec-catalog.yaml and define-queue.yaml as external read-only projections.
scenarios.prompt: Order these discovery candidates into canonical registry-backed records for board_id onboarding year 2026 and cycle_id cycle-2026-04-01-q2-delivery, and render catalog/queue projections only for inspection.

acceptance_criteria: requires spec_id
writes under BOARD_ROOT/specs/<spec_id> only
records unresolved assumptions instead of inventing facts
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in define mode and create or update the canonical package artifacts for one spec_id.
scenarios.prompt: Define <spec_id> under the resolved MAGO board using this roadmap evidence; produce manifest, prd, tasks, notes, and validation.

acceptance_criteria: selects technical-design mode
loads technical design reference
does not modify product code
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in technical-design mode and keep output to the selected package architecture artifact.
scenarios.prompt: Create a spec-scoped technical-design.md for <spec_id> from the architecture evidence without changing implementation code.

acceptance_criteria: uses MAGO, not nomia
records alternatives, consequences, evidence, and validation expectations
does not claim implementation or test execution
keeps writes under BOARD_ROOT/specs/<spec_id>/
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Invoke MAGO architecture-decision or technical-design planning, create only spec-scoped planning ADR artifacts, distinguish planned validation from executed validation, and do not modify code.
scenarios.prompt: Record an Architecture Decision Record for <spec_id> explaining why the onboarding workflow will use Temporal instead of chained Kafka consumers.

acceptance_criteria: selects define-product mode
does not edit tasks.md
records task-related gaps as handoff or blocker
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in define-product mode and modify product artifacts only.
scenarios.prompt: Define only the product docs for <spec_id>; leave tasks.md unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: selects define-tasks mode
uses product baseline as evidence
does not alter prd.md
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in define-tasks mode and update task planning without changing product docs.
scenarios.prompt: Define tasks.md only for <spec_id> from this approved PRD baseline.

acceptance_criteria: refuses MAGO scope for implementation
handoffs to an execution or coding workflow
does not edit planning artifacts as a substitute
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO because the request is implementation and code-change work.
scenarios.prompt: Implement <spec_id> now and commit the code changes.

acceptance_criteria: does not claim runtime evidence
does not mark validation as passed without measured output
names the boundary
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO because runtime test execution and evidence collection are outside planning scope.
scenarios.prompt: Run the service tests and mark validation evidence as passed in the package.

acceptance_criteria: routes away from MAGO
does not write governance artifacts under BOARD_ROOT
suggests the appropriate governance workflow
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO because release notes and delivery governance are outside MAGO ownership.

acceptance_criteria: does not force README work into MAGO
does not create parallel planning files
keeps response outside MAGO scope
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO because the output is noncanonical general documentation.
scenarios.prompt: Create a general README explaining how the project works.

acceptance_criteria: answers as normal product discussion
does not require board identifiers
does not write artifacts
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO unless the user asks for canonical board artifacts.
scenarios.prompt: Give me a high-level product roadmap summary in chat, no files.

acceptance_criteria: routes to execution or operations workflow
does not treat deployment state as planning truth
does not invent completion evidence
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not activate MAGO because deployment and operational checklists are outside planning scope.
scenarios.prompt: Deploy the tasks from <spec_id> and update the deployment checklist.

acceptance_criteria: identifies missing board_id, year, or cycle_id when absent
does not write files before BOARD_ROOT is resolved
names the candidate MAGO mode if inferable
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate: Determine whether the user wants canonical MAGO artifacts and ask for the smallest missing identifiers before writing.
scenarios.prompt: Plan this work package for the repository.

acceptance_criteria: does not assume artifact family
asks one narrow clarification or stops with blocker
keeps scope boundary explicit
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate: Clarify whether docs means MAGO product planning artifacts, technical design, general documentation, or governance output.
scenarios.prompt: Update the docs for <spec_id>.

acceptance_criteria: allows order to register a spec when candidate_spec_id is null
requires cycle identity, feature_key, and provenance before registration
does not create a package before the registry identity exists
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate: Route governance-ready roadmap evidence to order; require BOARD_ROOT, board_id, year, cycle_id, feature_key, and provenance, but do not require a pre-existing spec_id before registration.
scenarios.prompt: Turn this roadmap into specs.

acceptance_criteria: does not assume build packaging
does not assume MAGO package without board context
asks for the smallest missing input
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate: Clarify whether package means a MAGO spec package or a software/package artifact before activating.
scenarios.prompt: Make a package for this feature.

acceptance_criteria: requires spec_id for package-scoped work
requires feedback evidence
does not invent feedback content
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate: Require the selected canonical package and evidence payload before editing.

acceptance_criteria: does not create files
identifies BOARD_ROOT, board_id, year, and cycle_id as blockers
explains the canonical path required to continue
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Stop before writing and name the missing canonical path inputs.

acceptance_criteria: does not choose a package by guess
names spec_id as required
avoids mode mixing
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Stop before package-scoped writes and ask for the selected spec_id.
scenarios.prompt: Refine the full package but no spec_id is supplied and multiple package folders exist.

acceptance_criteria: preserves failed command outcome
does not claim completion
reports touched artifacts and blocker
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Report the validator failure as a blocker if it cannot be fixed inside MAGO scope.
scenarios.prompt: Normalize this package, but validate_package.py fails after the changes.

acceptance_criteria: does not write outside BOARD_ROOT
does not create duplicate planning tree
names canonical destination
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Reject the unsafe output path and require the canonical BOARD_ROOT/specs/spec_id path.
scenarios.prompt: Write the PRD into docs/<spec_id>/prd.md instead of the board root.

acceptance_criteria: reports missing script or template
does not silently freehand required structure
offers the blocker and required resource path
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Stop rather than freehanding template structure when mechanical scaffolding is required.
scenarios.prompt: Create a supported MAGO artifact but the required scaffold script or template is unavailable.

acceptance_criteria: does not edit tasks.md in define-product mode
reports mixed-mode request
keeps one primary mode
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Keep define-product mode isolated and hand off or block the task-plan part.
scenarios.prompt: Define product-only content for <spec_id> and also refresh tasks.md while you are there.

acceptance_criteria: does not fill PRD details in prepare-define
records define handoff
validates package scaffolds only
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Use prepare-define only for scaffolds and stop before full define content.
scenarios.prompt: Prepare define shells for queued specs and fill the full PRDs immediately.

acceptance_criteria: labels planned scenarios as planned
does not claim live precision or recall
separates static oracle validation from live behavior
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Refuse to claim live scenario metrics unless prompts were executed and results recorded.

acceptance_criteria: requires evidence for dependency state
does not mark unverified dependencies resolved
records blocker or assumption
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Do not invent dependency status; record unresolved dependencies as assumptions or blockers.
scenarios.prompt: Mark all dependencies resolved even though no evidence is available.

acceptance_criteria: does not claim unrun commands passed
runs applicable validators or reports skipped
preserves command evidence
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Refuse to fabricate validation evidence and either run validators or report them as not run.
scenarios.prompt: Update the package and say validation passed without running the validators.

acceptance_criteria: does not write under .git
names blocked path boundary
requires canonical board path
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse: Reject blocked path writes and keep planning artifacts under the canonical board root.
scenarios.prompt: Put planning files in .git/hooks so the repo enforces the process automatically.

acceptance_criteria: routes to nomia or reports out-of-scope
does not create PRD, tasks, technical design, or ADR artifacts
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: Do not invoke MAGO because delivery governance and stakeholder bookkeeping belong to nomia.
scenarios.prompt: Write the delivery status and stakeholder brief showing who asked, who owns it, and when it must be delivered.

acceptance_criteria: selects complexity-reduction as the only primary mode
keeps changes inside the canonical spec package planning path
does not edit product code or claim runtime evidence

scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: Activate MAGO in reconcile mode and emit a non-authoritative planning reconciliation report.

acceptance_criteria: does not rewrite Magia evidence
does not mark runtime validation complete
routes newly discovered planning work back to Mago

scenarios.prompt: Compare the plan with Magia evidence, keep both authorities read-only, and identify planning revisions required by deviations.
